title: 56 跳不出真的跳不出啊   2255 三年12
slug: 苟在诸天从黑暗佛门开始
lines: 56.跳不出，真的跳不出啊...（22）
林南县外...
山头，盗匪，聚义厅。
“几处点儿都踩过了，等杀了县兵，我们直接去拿钱。记住，只拿钱，想玩女人，等钱搬回来了再玩不迟。”
“不错，县里没了县兵，没了那些碍眼的武者，这座县我们可以随意奸淫，玩他个三天三夜，然后再离开。”
“嘿，三当家，你不是总遗憾没婆娘给你生孩子嘛，这次...你播十个八个，生个痛快。”
“街头抓到就直接扒了，嘿...”
“咱们比赛，看谁玩的多。”
“小心虎咆帮！”
“怕个屁啊，虎咆帮本来就没多少高手，没了飞天老虎，下面的小兔崽子们是来让老子兴奋的么？”
盗匪们你一言我一语，眼中闪烁着凶光，淫邪，以及兴奋。
刀头舔血的想要不怕死，那就得寻刺激。
要么金钱，要么女人。
原本，这些盗匪是分散在各处的，但这一次却被老大召集了过来，要做一锤子买卖。
他们基本上都是江湖好手，而大当家则是一流高手。
县兵的前进路线早被知道了。
再加上这次有内应，那就更是十拿九稳。
内应会给县兵们下药...
药是上好的迷药，鬼市买的，花了些银子。
那些迷药也许骗不过“飞天老虎”邓啸，可县兵乃至普通江湖好手却无一能够逃过。
到时候，大当家，二当家联手对付邓啸，其余之人直接杀人就是了。
这些盗匪正聊着，忽的...
他们感到头顶似乎落下了一团黑影。
有人抬头，却见正午的烈日中央多了一点阴翳。
那阴翳飞速扩大。
越来越大。
化成一团卷着恶风的斑斓，从天猛降！
大当家才喊出一个字，就没了声音。
他被那从天而降的巨物砸中了。
滚滚烟尘里，一道金光飞冲折转。
一阵嘈杂，这“盗匪中枢的聚义厅”直接就安静了。
然后，又是一阵呼啸的风声和惨叫，外围也安静了。
数百人的盗匪寨子，所有盗匪都成了尸体。
李玄撤去了控制，任由金翅鸟进食。
“灭杀城外数百盗匪”对他来说已是随手的小事，根本不值得多用心。

56. I can’t jump out, I really can’t jump out...(22)
Outside Linnan County...
On the top of the mountain, bandits gathered in Yiyi Hall.
"We have trampled on several places. After killing the county soldiers, we will go directly to get the money. Remember, we only take the money. If you want to play with women, it is not too late to wait until the money comes back."
"That's right. Without the county soldiers and those unsightly warriors in the county, we can rape anyone we want in this county, play with them for three days and three nights, and then leave."
"Hey, Third Boss, don't you always regret that you don't have a mother-in-law to give you a baby? This time... you can give birth to ten or eight babies and have a happy birth."
"If you catch me on the street, just pick it up, hey..."
"Let's compete to see who can play more."
"Be careful of the Tiger Roar Gang!"
"You're so scared. The Tiger Roar Gang doesn't have many experts to begin with. Without the Flying Tiger, are the little bastards below here to make me excited?"
The robbers spoke to each other, their eyes flashing with fierceness, lust, and excitement.
If you want to avoid death if you want to lick blood with the blade of the knife, you have to look for excitement.
Either money or women.
Originally, these bandits were scattered everywhere, but this time they were summoned by the boss to make a deal.
They are basically all masters of the arena, and the big boss is a first-rate master.
The advance route of the county soldiers has long been known.
Coupled with the fact that there is an internal response this time, it is even more certain.
Internally, the county soldiers will be drugged...
The medicine was a good drug. I bought it at the ghost market and spent some money on it.
Those poisonous drugs may not be able to deceive "Flying Tiger" Deng Xiao, but no one from the county soldiers or even ordinary martial arts masters can escape.
At that time, the first master and the second master will work together to deal with Deng Xiao, and the rest will just kill people.
These bandits were chatting when suddenly...
They felt as if a dark shadow had fallen above their heads.
Someone looked up and saw that there was a little more shadow in the middle of the scorching sun at noon.
The shadow expanded rapidly.
getting bigger and bigger.
It turned into a beautiful ball with evil wind and fell from the sky!
"Hide..."
The boss just yelled one word, and then his voice fell silent.
He was hit by the giant thing falling from the sky.
In the billowing smoke and dust, a golden light flew and turned.
After a burst of noise, the "Gathering Hall of the Bandit Center" immediately fell silent.
Then, there was another burst of howling wind and screams, and the surrounding area became quiet.
There were hundreds of people in the bandit camp, and all the bandits were turned into corpses.
Li Xuan removed the control and allowed the golden-winged bird to eat.
"Killing hundreds of bandits outside the city" is already a trivial matter for him, and it is not worth paying much attention to.
